title: AppBinding v1 (DRAFT — Phase 2 PLG-205 locks it)
description: The host-authoritative record binding one ConnectorInstance to one app (ADR-002). The Desktop persists the local record; the hosted deployment persists the matching remote record; reconnect reconciles two-sided. Every command/event is stamped with these identities plus the binding epoch; stale epochs fail closed.

pluginInstallationId.description: stable per-install id (survives updates; a reinstall mints a new one and the binding shows 'missing' until reconnected)

epoch.description: incremented on every ownership change; commands/events with a stale epoch fail closed

offlinePolicy.description: How long the last server-confirmed binding remains honoured offline. Offline can never create or transfer ownership.
